# sse-stream-parser

> Incremental Server-Sent Events parser for LLM streaming responses, with correct chunk-boundary handling.

sse-stream-parser is a spec-correct, incremental SSE (Server-Sent Events)
parser built for LLM streaming (OpenAI/Anthropic-style chat completions
over SSE). Feed it raw text chunks as they arrive over the wire — in any
byte alignment, including split mid-line, mid-field, or mid-event — via
`feed(chunk)`, and it returns only the SSEEvent(s) that became complete.
It handles multi-line `data:` fields (joined per spec), `event:`/`id:`/
`retry:` fields, `:`-prefixed comment lines, and both CRLF and LF line
endings. It also ships the `[DONE]` sentinel-event convention used by
OpenAI-style streams and a JSON-delta accumulator helper for reassembling
incremental content deltas into a running string. Zero runtime
dependencies, strict TypeScript.

## API

- `class SSEParser { feed(chunk: string): SSEEvent[]; flush(): SSEEvent[] }`
- `isDoneEvent(event: SSEEvent): boolean`
- `createDeltaAccumulator(extract: (parsed: unknown) => string | null | undefined): DeltaAccumulator`
- Types: `SSEEvent { data, event, id?, retry? }`, `DeltaAccumulator { feed(event), text, reset() }`

## Install

```
npm install sse-stream-parser
```

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
